fsm.description: Two arms facing each other, each pick&placing its own cube in lockstep; paths only home->pick_above, geometric setpoints elsewhere. Grasp-loss on either arm during transport (lift/place_above/place) routes to S_RECOVER, which captures and holds both current poses.
fsm.name: pick_place_dual_fsm

description: Hold both TCPs at their startup home poses
motions.name: home

description: Move both TCPs to the pre-grasp position above their cubes along paths
motions.name: pick-above

description: Lower both TCPs straight down to the grasp height at their cubes
motions.name: pick

description: Hold both TCPs at their current base-frame poses while the grippers close
motions.name: grasp-hold

description: Raise both TCPs straight up while holding the cubes
motions.name: lift

description: Move both TCPs laterally to the pre-place position above their place locations
motions.name: place-above

description: Lower both TCPs with cubes straight down to the place height
motions.name: place

description: Hold both TCPs at place pose while the grippers open
motions.name: open-grasp-hold

description: Move both TCPs straight up to the pre-grasp height above the place locations
motions.name: retreat

description: Fallback recovery: capture both current poses on entry and hold them
motions.name: recover
